newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends mixed, deferreds up on crop concern.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends mixed, deferreds up on crop concern.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended mixed Friday, with new-crop months up on concerns a cool wet spring would slow plant development, pit sources said.
"What is continuing to support this market is that we've got a delayed crop on our hands," a trader said. "It is more susceptible to disease and weed problems."
Nearbys were down on long liquidation below $11.50 in the July. Funds were said to be sellers.
Rice ended nine cents lower to two cents higher, with July down 6-1/2 at $11.47 per cwt. Volume was estimated by CBOT at 550 lots against Thursday's actual volume of 267.
